interpretation: CPU microbenchmarks under recorded concurrent load, without a host timing gate. This fills the absent receiver-history path in service-qualification-cpu-v1; it is not host throughput acceptance.
invariants: Exactly128 active RTT samples; correct per-message and cumulative-head byte accounting;1 or32 messages per operation; zero allocations.
raw_logs: Excluded; numerical rows, exact source/binary hashes and safe run context are retained.
scope: Three full-receiver-history timing-plus-credit publication benchmarks, three nonrace repetitions per immutable variant. Every iteration refreshes its paired timing; no timestamp ring expires during the measurement.
source_boundary: Sampler qualification54b36054 versus008e9d38, with the same new benchmark file overlaid onto each copied source. Later queue-horizon, cumulative-pacing and writer-ownership corrections are excluded.
